verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de is a notarization/incorporation API service, not a data-storage platform, but the story asks whether users can export their own data (documents, records) in open formats and leave — no evidence of any export/download-all-data feature or data portability mechanism appears anywhere in the docs. This is a fair question since users submit sensitive documents and company data that they'd reasonably want to retrieve or migrate away with, so the axis applies, and no evidence of such a capability exists.
